supersedes: 1.0.0 (per-orientation peak only; retained on disk as legacy/secondary)
source: PVGIS (EU JRC) — PVGIS-SARAH3 radiation + ERA5 meteorology
method: TMY hourly global irradiance, isotropic (Liu-Jordan) transposition to vertical (tilt 90); vendored JJA hourly design series enabling simultaneous room design peak
orientationConvention: azimuth from North, clockwise: N=0, NE=45, E=90, SE=135, S=180, SW=225, W=270, NW=315
transposition: isotropic sky: G_vert = DNI*cos(theta_i) + DHI*0.5 + GHI*albedo*0.5; albedo=0.2; vertical tilt=90
assumptions: Locality centroid coordinates per station (same as v1); <1% irradiance effect.
yerevan-agro and yerevan-arabkir share Yerevan centroid (same PVGIS grid cell).
Isotropic sky model ignores horizon brightening/circumsolar (APPROVED_WITH_LIMITATION).
Hourly irradiance rounded to 0.1 W/m2; peaks are per-orientation JJA maxima (identical to v1).
